metric: MSE of cell-averaged RGB over the active image
measured_against: scaled source before Spectrum palette quantization

colour_comparison.chroma_metric: Squared R-G and B-G differences; not a perceptual grade
colour_comparison.selector: source-bounded palette + localized gray seam feathering
colour_comparison.source_guard_scope: Baseline keeps original sample/physical bounds; a narrow gray seam band may introduce sparse fractional levels outside those bounds. Measure its actual errors explicitly.
colour_comparison.fractional_density_phase: Screen-anchored R2 sequence only inside the seam band, constant in time
colour_comparison.quality_tradeoff: Localized feathering may increase pixel MSE; no whole-image fractional retexturing
